longDesc.template:
Something terrible is happening. The whole of Ballincollig is screaming.

I need to get to our flat in Bishopstown and find my {Partner}, {PartnerName}.
The flat is at the end of the terrace off Curraheen Road. Please God let my {Partner} be ok.
{PartnerNameShort} isn't here. I need to find out where {PartnerSex} has gone.
My {Partner} {PartnerNameShort} left a note saying {PartnerSex} went in to help out. CUH is behind an Army cordon, so it has to be the Mercy, over on the Mardyke side.
The Mercy was where {PartnerName} said {PartnerSex}'d be.

quest905.shortDesc: Work your way out to Páirc Uí Chaoimh

longDesc.template:
One of the nurses said the Army took everyone out to Páirc Uí Chaoimh, {PartnerName} included.

Go through the City Centre and Shandon, past Kent Station, and out to Blackrock.
The soldier at the gate told you to report to the registration officer. Maybe they have a record of where {PartnerName} is.
The list says {PartnerName} was relocated. Find out where they sent {PartnerSexAddress}.
Find someone in the ground who knows what happened to {PartnerName}.

quest909.longDesc: Barry asked you to meet him in the maintenance room behind the Gents at the ground.

quest910.longDesc: Talk to Barry to find out what the plan is.

quest911.longDesc: Barry wants you to find out what the Emergency Response Command is really at in the ground.

quest912.shortDesc: Return to Barry with the info
quest912.longDesc: You have papers that say the relocated are going to the Butter Exchange in Shandon. Go and tell Barry.

longDesc.template: All the evidence says {PartnerName} is in the Butter Exchange in Shandon. Go and meet Barry above in Hegarty's Hardware.
Use the culvert key to get under the wall of the ERC compound at the Butter Exchange and find {PartnerName}.
{PartnerName} is locked in a cell. Take the cell key off the ERC guard and get them out.

quest916.longDesc: Go to the quays in Cobh and find a boat.

quest917.longDesc: Go to Haulbowline Naval Base, out past Ringaskiddy, and find some explosives.

quest918.longDesc: We're going to need blocks of C4, blasting caps and a timer.

quest919.longDesc: Go to the container wall on the pier road with Jack and get ready for the final push.

quest001.longDesc:
Ed is trying to get through the Army fence. It's the only way into Bishopstown and our flat.
He needs bolt cutters to get through.
He says Ray at number 12 has a pair.

quest003.longDesc: Ray says Ed never gave back his bolt cutters. I should go and tell Ed he has them.

quest004.longDesc: Ed gave me the key to his garage at number 14. The bolt cutters should be in there somewhere.

quest002.longDesc: Hank Crowley, who owns the gun shop on Western Road, needs me to find his da's rifle and the bolt group for it. They're in his flat, number 202, down the road from the shop. He gave me his neighbour's key to get in.

quest005.longDesc: The soldier will follow you if you talk to him.

quest006.longDesc: Dinny says he can make you something to crack skulls if you find him the materials.

quest007.longDesc: Dinny has plans for something fierce nasty, if you can find the materials.

quest008.longDesc: Dinny has plans for a suppressed pistol. Not sure where a tinkerer from Bishopstown learned to make something like this.

quest009.longDesc: Lee Security staff are stuck in their offices on St Patrick's Street. They need the weapons from their cage, and a young lad named Duggan took the key and headed for Shandon. Find the key and bring it back to Lee Security.

quest010.longDesc: Get the key off Duggan's body and bring it back to Lee Security on St Patrick's Street to open the cage.

quest011.longDesc:
Kelly, who works in Dinny's Corner Shop in Bishopstown, has lost her glasses and can't go anywhere without them.

She thinks she dropped them on the floor.

quest015.longDesc: Jer, Paudie and their 'friends' are stranded with the van not working. They need petrol and parts to get it going again.

quest016.longDesc: Directions to the cabin: Go left, up, turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick.

quest017.longDesc: Find 4 blood samples on corpses in Ballea Woods. Dr Philip Hurley thinks he can find out more about what's going on from that.

quest500.longDesc: Clear the road ahead of the Gone for Fred.
